ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely high ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 98% low-intensity black.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region across 98% of the fluke; high-intensity white clusters localized at the extreme distal tips (corners) of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 80 degrees relative to the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations observed along the entire trailing boundary; irregular peak-to-valley pixel variance ranging from 2 to 15 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge extending from the median notch to the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized at the extreme left and right tips, consistent with localized distal scarring.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, low-contrast diagonal linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized white pigmentation/scarring present at the extreme distal points of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Small irregular white notch-like pigmentation at the junction where the left lobe meets the peduncle area.
